name: Freshwater Bay House (HF Holidays)
accommodation: 43 en-suite rooms in Classic, Premium and Superior categories
suitableFor: Walkers, groups and families wanting full board with organised walks
beachAccess: A short walk from Freshwater Bay; garden paths lead down to the beach
confirmedFeatures: Full board, bar, restaurant, three lounges, boot and drying room, outdoor heated pool (May to September), EV charging
overview: Freshwater Bay House is an HF Holidays country house just above Freshwater Bay, with garden paths leading down to the beach. Its 43 en-suite rooms come full board, and there is a bar, lounges and an outdoor pool in summer. The boot and drying room and guided walks make it a natural choice for people spending the day outdoors.
surfTripFit: The boot and drying room handles wet kit, and the beach is down the garden path.
